thread.listingTitle: Small single room at Kangaroo Point, Brisbane

messages.text:
Hi, is the room(small single room) still available? I’m Seo yeon from South Korea. And the Inspection is possible from March 16,(tomorrow) and I’m looking for a place to stay for at least 2 month and up to 6 months or longer.
I studied primary education and worked as a primary school instructor for 4 years. I recently came to Australia to experience living in a new country and language.
I’m a non-smoker, very clean and respectful, and I enjoy a peaceful home environment. I’m also friendly, polite, and easy to live with.
I saw your post about the room and I’m really interested. If it’s still available, I’d love to arrange an inspection.
Hope to hear from you soon. Thank you! 😊
